//Logging: NEVER set System.Net.Http.HttpClient to Trace in production - it logs request headers, tokens included (README §E.6).
//Okta: Fill in from README Appendix B. None of this is secret — a public client has no secrets (README §E.3). If you find yourself adding a ClientSecret, the app is registered as the wrong type in Okta.

Okta.//RedirectPorts: EVERY port here must also be registered as a redirect URI in Okta (README §4.3, §6.5). The client probes them in order and fails over when one is bound.
Okta.//PersistSession: Set false on shared or kiosk machines — DPAPI CurrentUser gives no isolation between people sharing one Windows account (README §E.7).
